'''Toshiki Sato''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 56, from Chofu City, Japan. After Decipher's SWCCG run, the slot was marked Retired.<ref name="sm-fan" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
